content.short: Dopex is a maximum liquidity and minimal exposure options protocol.
content.description: Dopex (DPX) is a decentralized options protocol built to improve liquidity while limiting losses for option writers and increasing potential returns for option buyers. Options trading can be intricate, and efficient, buyer- and writer-friendly setups are notoriously difficult to achieve. Dopex seeks to simplify these dynamics by delivering higher liquidity, improved capital efficiency, and lower costs, targeting a more accessible options market across supported networks, including the Arbitrum ecosystem. This approach lowers barriers and enhances overall participation in options trading.
